name: Stable.com
description: Stable.com is a read-only information and order-tracking companion for the Stable platform. It looks up supported networks and assets, estimates indicative rates and fees, tracks the status of swaps a user has already started, and shows wallet balances and token allowances. The app does not execute trades, move or hold funds, or provide investment advice; any action is completed by the user on the Stable platform at stable.com.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Stable.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Stable.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api-defi.stable.com/v1/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Stable.com MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Stable.com scores 88/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Stable.com MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stable.com provides these MCP tools: account_get_allowances, account_get_balances, swap_get_config, swap_get_crosschain_status, swap_get_quote, swap_get_singlechain_status, and swap_validate_lock.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Stable.com?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Stable.com in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Stable.com does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Stable.com is developed by Stable.com. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
